notes: Fields no longer zoom the iPhone screen in when you tap them, and the screen keeps the field you are typing in just above the keyboard.
If the screen was zoomed in, the Route tab no longer freezes. The bottom bar and scrolling keep working.
Save Draft on a test now shows Draft Saved, and tapping Test on that device again reopens your draft instead of a blank form.
Edit Address saves without a ZIP. Before, Save stayed gray on addresses with no ZIP. If Save is off, the reason shows next to it.
Send To City on a test report emails the PDF from FlowField. For now it is in Test Mode and goes to the FlowField test inbox. The screen says so and shows the city address it will go to later.
